reports #### ISI Report 2025 In September 2023, a new inspection framework was introduced which changed the nature of both the inspection itself and the report subsequently published. Instead of areas of the school being graded ('excellent' etc), the standards are either 'met' or 'not met'. I am very pleased to confirm that St Mary's met all the standards required, demonstrating full compliance. We are proud that so many areas of the school have been singled out for praise which reflects the quality of the education we provide across the board. In order to reach their judgements, the 7-strong inspection team interviewed over ¼ of the student body, held meetings with 90 staff attendees (some staff had multiple meetings owing to various areas of responsibility), observed 25 registration and assembly slots, and visited around 100 lessons. We are thrilled to share some of the report's key findings: > "Leaders have a clear vision for school development based on effective monitoring and self-evaluation." > "From early years and upwards, pupils show high levels of respect and tolerance. Consequently, behaviour is good and bullying is rare." > "Boarding provision is carefully led and managed by knowledgeable and experienced staff. Conscientious supervision and a rigorous approach to safety ensure that boarders feel safe." > "Teachers have a high level of knowledge and enthusiasm for their subjects." > "Pupils feel safe and respected, with trusted staff always available." #### ISI Report 2025

In September 2023, a new inspection framework was introduced which changed the nature of both the inspection itself and the report subsequently published. Instead of areas of the school being graded ('excellent' etc), the standards are either 'met' or 'not met'. I am very pleased to confirm that St Mary's met all the standards required, demonstrating full compliance. We are proud that so many areas of the school have been singled out for praise which reflects the quality of the education we provide across the board.

In order to reach their judgements, the 7-strong inspection team interviewed over ¼ of the student body, held meetings with 90 staff attendees (some staff had multiple meetings owing to various areas of responsibility), observed 25 registration and assembly slots, and visited around 100 lessons.

We are thrilled to share some of the report's key findings:

> "Leaders have a clear vision for school development based on effective monitoring and self-evaluation."

> "From early years and upwards, pupils show high levels of respect and tolerance. Consequently, behaviour is good and bullying is rare."

> "Boarding provision is carefully led and managed by knowledgeable and experienced staff. Conscientious supervision and a rigorous approach to safety ensure that boarders feel safe."

> "Teachers have a high level of knowledge and enthusiasm for their subjects."

> "Pupils feel safe and respected, with trusted staff always available."

[**Read the full report**](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/publications-and-media-galleries/reports.htm)

### Diocesan inspection report 2022

Our [Diocesan Inspection report](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/ugc-1/1/6/0/dea_final_report_st_marys_independen.pdf) undertaken by the East Anglia Diocesan Schools’ Service achieved the highest ‘**Grade 1’ rating of Outstanding** in all three areas assessed by inspectors in June 2022: Catholic Life, Religious Education and Collective Worship.  
  
Inspectors praised St Mary’s as: ‘_a school where everyone is respected and valued for who they are_’, with the quality of leadership described as ‘_extremely strong; it is both enterprising and aspirational_.’

> Inspectors reported _‘it is evident that the core Gospel values lie at the heart of life in school, clearly witnessed by the positive and caring relationships that exist between all groups.’_

### Parking

We encourage the use of public transport and bicycles where possible and due to our central Cambridge location, we are unfortunately unable to offer visitor parking.

There are metered parking bays on Trumpington Road, only a few minutes’ walk to the [Junior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school.htm), [Senior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/senior-school.htm), [Sixth Form](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/sixth-form.htm) and Art Centre. Parking bays in residential streets near our main entrances are for residents only or, where notified, for short stay, normally for a maximum of two hours.

### By road

#### **From the north, midlands and east**

*   Follow the M11 southbound (via the A14 from the midlands and east)

*   Exit at Junction 12

*   Take Barton Road to the roundabout and turn right onto Fen Causeway

*   Continue to the next roundabout and take the second exit

*   Continue into Trumpington Road

###### _For_**_Junior School_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road until you arrive at **Chaucer Road**, on the right.

*   **Junior School** is located on the right – **6 Chaucer Road**.

###### _For_**_Senior School_**_,_**_Sixth Form_**_and our_**_Art Centre_**

*   Turn left into **Bateman Street**

*   For **Sixth Form** turn immediately left into **Brookside** – the Sixth Form is on your right

*   For **Senior School**continue down Bateman Street, and the school is on the **right**opposite Panton Street, beyond the bollards

*   Our **Art Centre** is just beyond the Senior School, also on the right and beyond the bollards

###### _For_**_Mary Ward House (Boarding)_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road and turn left into Brooklands Avenue

*   **Mary Ward House** is located on the left-hand side, opposite Clarendon Road

###### **_For Long Road Sports Ground_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road and turn left into Long Road

*   The Long Road Sports Ground is about halfway down Long Road, on the right-hand side

#### **From the south**

*   Take Junction 11 off the M11 and follow Trumpington Road for about one mile into Cambridge

###### _For_**_Junior School_**

*   Just past the **Nuffield Hospital** on your right, turn left into **Chaucer Road**

*   The Junior School is located on the right – **6 Chaucer Road**

###### _For_**_Senior School_**_,_**_Sixth Form_**_and our_**_Art Centre_**

*   Just past **Cambridge University Botanic Garden** on the right, turn right into Bateman Street

*   For **Sixth Form** turn immediately left into Brookside – the Sixth Form will be on your right

*   For **Senior School**continue down Bateman Street, and the school is located on the right opposite Panton Street, beyond the bollards

*   The **Art Centre** is just beyond **Senior School**, also on the right

###### _For_**_Mary Ward House (Boarding)_**

*   Just past the **Nuffield Hospital** turn right into Brooklands Avenue

*   **Mary Ward House** is located on the left-hand side, opposite Clarendon Road

###### **_For Long Road Sports Ground_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road and turn right into Long Road

*   The Long Road Sports Ground is about halfway down Long Road, on the right-hand side

### By train

There are frequent trains from London King's Cross and from Liverpool Street to Cambridge. There are also good connections from Peterborough, Birmingham, Manchester and Edinburgh. **Senior School**, **Sixth Form** and **Art Centre** are five minutes by taxi from Cambridge Station or a 10-minute walk. **Junior School** is a further five-minute walk.

###### **Walking from the station:**

*   Walk down Station Road towards Hills Road

*   Turn right onto Hills Road and continue until you reach Bateman Street

*   Turn left onto Bateman Street:

    *   The **Art Centre**is on the left after approximately 500 yards

    *   **Senior School**is just beyond the Art Centre, opposite Panton Street

    *   Near the end of Bateman Street, turn right into Brookside – the **Sixth Form** is on your right

    *   For **Junior School**, continue to the end of Bateman Street, and turn left onto Trumpington Road

    *   At the next traffic lights, turn right into Chaucer Road - **Junior School** is 6 Chaucer Road

**Mary Ward House (Boarding) walking from the station:**

*   Turn left into **Station Place**

*   Turn right into **Brookgate**

*   Cross Hills Road and turn right into **Brooklands Avenue**

*   Mary Ward House is on the right-hand side opposite Clarendon Road

**Long Road Sports Ground walking from the station:**

*   Turn left into **Station Place**

*   Turn right into **Brookgate**

*   Turn left onto **Hills Road** and continue along this road

*   Cross over the railway bridge and continue until you reach a right turn into Long Road

*   St Mary's Sports Ground is located about halfway along Long Road on the left-hand side

### Park and ride

There are regular Park and Ride buses that drop off near St Mary's School from both [Trumpington](http://cambridgeparkandride.info/trumpington.shtml) and [Babraham](http://cambridgeparkandride.info/babrahamroad.shtml) Park and Ride stations.

###### **Trumpington Park and Ride**

*   Alight at the Cambridge University Botanic Garden stop and continue in the same direction, crossing the road into Bateman Street on the right

*   For **Sixth Form** turn left into Brookside – the Sixth Form is on the right

*   For **Senior School** continue down Bateman Street approximately 200 yards; the school is on the right opposite Panton Street, beyond the bollards

*   The **Art Centre** is just beyond Senior School, also on the right

###### **Babraham Park and Ride**

*   Alight at Cambridge Railway Station

*   Walk down Station Road towards Hills Road

*   Turn right onto Hills Road and continue until you reach Bateman Street

*   Turn left onto Bateman Street:

    *   The **Art Centre**is on the left after approximately 500 yards

    *   **Senior School**is just beyond the Art Centre, opposite Panton Street.

    *   Near the end of Bateman Street, turn right into Brookside – the **Sixth Form** is on your right

### Parking

We encourage the use of public transport and bicycles where possible and due to our central Cambridge location, we are unfortunately unable to offer visitor parking.

There are metered parking bays on Trumpington Road, only a few minutes’ walk to the [Junior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school.htm), [Senior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/senior-school.htm), [Sixth Form](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/sixth-form.htm) and Art Centre. Parking bays in residential streets near our main entrances are for residents only or, where notified, for short stay, normally for a maximum of two hours.

### By road

#### **From the north, midlands and east**

*   Follow the M11 southbound (via the A14 from the midlands and east)

*   Exit at Junction 12

*   Take Barton Road to the roundabout and turn right onto Fen Causeway

*   Continue to the next roundabout and take the second exit

*   Continue into Trumpington Road

###### _For_**_Junior School_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road until you arrive at **Chaucer Road**, on the right.

*   **Junior School** is located on the right – **6 Chaucer Road**.

###### _For_**_Senior School_**_,_**_Sixth Form_**_and our_**_Art Centre_**

*   Turn left into **Bateman Street**

*   For **Sixth Form** turn immediately left into **Brookside** – the Sixth Form is on your right

*   For **Senior School**continue down Bateman Street, and the school is on the **right**opposite Panton Street, beyond the bollards

*   Our **Art Centre** is just beyond the Senior School, also on the right and beyond the bollards

###### _For_**_Mary Ward House (Boarding)_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road and turn left into Brooklands Avenue

*   **Mary Ward House** is located on the left-hand side, opposite Clarendon Road

###### **_For Long Road Sports Ground_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road and turn left into Long Road

*   The Long Road Sports Ground is about halfway down Long Road, on the right-hand side

#### **From the south**

*   Take Junction 11 off the M11 and follow Trumpington Road for about one mile into Cambridge

###### _For_**_Junior School_**

*   Just past the **Nuffield Hospital** on your right, turn left into **Chaucer Road**

*   The Junior School is located on the right – **6 Chaucer Road**

###### _For_**_Senior School_**_,_**_Sixth Form_**_and our_**_Art Centre_**

*   Just past **Cambridge University Botanic Garden** on the right, turn right into Bateman Street

*   For **Sixth Form** turn immediately left into Brookside – the Sixth Form will be on your right

*   For **Senior School**continue down Bateman Street, and the school is located on the right opposite Panton Street, beyond the bollards

*   The **Art Centre** is just beyond **Senior School**, also on the right

###### _For_**_Mary Ward House (Boarding)_**

*   Just past the **Nuffield Hospital** turn right into Brooklands Avenue

*   **Mary Ward House** is located on the left-hand side, opposite Clarendon Road

###### **_For Long Road Sports Ground_**

*   Continue along Trumpington Road and turn right into Long Road

*   The Long Road Sports Ground is about halfway down Long Road, on the right-hand side

### By train

There are frequent trains from London King's Cross and from Liverpool Street to Cambridge. There are also good connections from Peterborough, Birmingham, Manchester and Edinburgh. **Senior School**, **Sixth Form** and **Art Centre** are five minutes by taxi from Cambridge Station or a 10-minute walk. **Junior School** is a further five-minute walk.

###### **Walking from the station:**

*   Walk down Station Road towards Hills Road

*   Turn right onto Hills Road and continue until you reach Bateman Street

*   Turn left onto Bateman Street:

    *   The **Art Centre**is on the left after approximately 500 yards

    *   **Senior School**is just beyond the Art Centre, opposite Panton Street

    *   Near the end of Bateman Street, turn right into Brookside – the **Sixth Form** is on your right

    *   For **Junior School**, continue to the end of Bateman Street, and turn left onto Trumpington Road

    *   At the next traffic lights, turn right into Chaucer Road - **Junior School** is 6 Chaucer Road

**Mary Ward House (Boarding) walking from the station:**

*   Turn left into **Station Place**

*   Turn right into **Brookgate**

*   Cross Hills Road and turn right into **Brooklands Avenue**

*   Mary Ward House is on the right-hand side opposite Clarendon Road

**Long Road Sports Ground walking from the station:**

*   Turn left into **Station Place**

*   Turn right into **Brookgate**

*   Turn left onto **Hills Road** and continue along this road

*   Cross over the railway bridge and continue until you reach a right turn into Long Road

*   St Mary's Sports Ground is located about halfway along Long Road on the left-hand side

### Park and ride

There are regular Park and Ride buses that drop off near St Mary's School from both [Trumpington](http://cambridgeparkandride.info/trumpington.shtml) and [Babraham](http://cambridgeparkandride.info/babrahamroad.shtml) Park and Ride stations.

###### **Trumpington Park and Ride**

*   Alight at the Cambridge University Botanic Garden stop and continue in the same direction, crossing the road into Bateman Street on the right

*   For **Sixth Form** turn left into Brookside – the Sixth Form is on the right

*   For **Senior School** continue down Bateman Street approximately 200 yards; the school is on the right opposite Panton Street, beyond the bollards

*   The **Art Centre** is just beyond Senior School, also on the right

###### **Babraham Park and Ride**

*   Alight at Cambridge Railway Station

*   Walk down Station Road towards Hills Road

*   Turn right onto Hills Road and continue until you reach Bateman Street

*   Turn left onto Bateman Street:

    *   The **Art Centre**is on the left after approximately 500 yards

    *   **Senior School**is just beyond the Art Centre, opposite Panton Street.

    *   Near the end of Bateman Street, turn right into Brookside – the **Sixth Form** is on your right

### Minibus shuttle services

We operate a minibus service for students in Year 1 and above**,**from the following locations:

*   Babraham Park and Ride

*   Madingley Park and Ride

*   Cambourne

*   Trumpington Park and Ride

*   Milton Park & Ride

###### Charges for minibuses (from September 2026)

Parents will be billed in advance, on a termly basis for the bookings made via the Vectare parent app.

The daily cost per route is as follows:

| **Stop point** | **Cost per journey (from September 2026)** | **Return (from September 2026)** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trumpington Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |
| Babraham Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |
| Madingley Road Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |
| The Hub, Cambourne | £2.90 | £5.20 |
| Milton Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |

**Please note**: Ad hoc bookings are not available for students not registered for the service.

These services are subject to availability and offered on a first come first served basis. Please contact our Operations Manager at: [**minibus@stmaryscambridge.co.uk**](mailto:minibus@stmaryscambridge.co.uk)to book a space for your daughter or with any enquiries about this service.

The published arrival/departure times are estimated and may vary slightly due to traffic congestion. Please ensure your child arrives at the departure point a few minutes before the published times. We also a offer minibus service between the [Junior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school.htm) and [Senior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/senior-school.htm) to assist families with students at each site.

### Train

Cambridge Station is just a ten minute walk away from our [Junior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school.htm), [Senior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/senior-school.htm), [Sixth Form](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/sixth-form.htm) and [Boarding](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/boarding.htm) accommodation.

*   Students aged 16-18 are eligible for the C[ambridgeshire Student Connect Scheme](https://www.greatnorthernrail.com/tickets/discounts-and-railcards/student-connect) with Great Northern trains offering a **50% discount** on rail travel

*   Students aged 16-18 are eligible for the [Greater Anglia Academic Season](https://railplus.greateranglia.co.uk/scholars.html) Passes, offering **up to 57% discount** on rail travel

### Cycle

We run annual _Bikeability_ sessions which teach safety and confidence, to encourage our girls to get active by travelling by bike. We have bicycle parks at the Junior School, Senior School and Sixth Form.

### Minibus shuttle services

We operate a minibus service for students in Year 1 and above**,**from the following locations:

*   Babraham Park and Ride

*   Madingley Park and Ride

*   Cambourne

*   Trumpington Park and Ride

*   Milton Park & Ride

###### Charges for minibuses (from September 2026)

Parents will be billed in advance, on a termly basis for the bookings made via the Vectare parent app.

The daily cost per route is as follows:

| **Stop point** | **Cost per journey (from September 2026)** | **Return (from September 2026)** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trumpington Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |
| Babraham Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |
| Madingley Road Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |
| The Hub, Cambourne | £2.90 | £5.20 |
| Milton Park & Ride | £2.10 | £3.50 |

**Please note**: Ad hoc bookings are not available for students not registered for the service.

These services are subject to availability and offered on a first come first served basis. Please contact our Operations Manager at: [**minibus@stmaryscambridge.co.uk**](mailto:minibus@stmaryscambridge.co.uk)to book a space for your daughter or with any enquiries about this service.

The published arrival/departure times are estimated and may vary slightly due to traffic congestion. Please ensure your child arrives at the departure point a few minutes before the published times. We also a offer minibus service between the [Junior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school.htm) and [Senior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/senior-school.htm) to assist families with students at each site.

### Train

Cambridge Station is just a ten minute walk away from our [Junior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school.htm), [Senior School](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/senior-school.htm), [Sixth Form](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/sixth-form.htm) and [Boarding](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/boarding.htm) accommodation.

*   Students aged 16-18 are eligible for the C[ambridgeshire Student Connect Scheme](https://www.greatnorthernrail.com/tickets/discounts-and-railcards/student-connect) with Great Northern trains offering a **50% discount** on rail travel

*   Students aged 16-18 are eligible for the [Greater Anglia Academic Season](https://railplus.greateranglia.co.uk/scholars.html) Passes, offering **up to 57% discount** on rail travel

### Cycle

We run annual _Bikeability_ sessions which teach safety and confidence, to encourage our girls to get active by travelling by bike. We have bicycle parks at the Junior School, Senior School and Sixth Form.

#### ISI Report 2025

In September 2023, a new inspection framework was introduced which changed the nature of both the inspection itself and the report subsequently published. Instead of areas of the school being graded ('excellent' etc), the standards are either 'met' or 'not met'. I am very pleased to confirm that St Mary's met all the standards required, demonstrating full compliance. We are proud that so many areas of the school have been singled out for praise which reflects the quality of the education we provide across the board.

In order to reach their judgements, the 7-strong inspection team interviewed over ¼ of the student body, held meetings with 90 staff attendees (some staff had multiple meetings owing to various areas of responsibility), observed 25 registration and assembly slots, and visited around 100 lessons.

We are thrilled to share some of the report's key findings:

> "Leaders have a clear vision for school development based on effective monitoring and self-evaluation."

> "From early years and upwards, pupils show high levels of respect and tolerance. Consequently, behaviour is good and bullying is rare."

> "Boarding provision is carefully led and managed by knowledgeable and experienced staff. Conscientious supervision and a rigorous approach to safety ensure that boarders feel safe."

> "Teachers have a high level of knowledge and enthusiasm for their subjects."

> "Pupils feel safe and respected, with trusted staff always available."

[**Read the full report**](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/publications-and-media-galleries/reports.htm)

### Diocesan inspection report 2022

Our [Diocesan Inspection report](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/ugc-1/1/6/0/dea_final_report_st_marys_independen.pdf) undertaken by the East Anglia Diocesan Schools’ Service achieved the highest ‘**Grade 1’ rating of Outstanding** in all three areas assessed by inspectors in June 2022: Catholic Life, Religious Education and Collective Worship.  
  
Inspectors praised St Mary’s as: ‘_a school where everyone is respected and valued for who they are_’, with the quality of leadership described as ‘_extremely strong; it is both enterprising and aspirational_.’

> Inspectors reported _‘it is evident that the core Gospel values lie at the heart of life in school, clearly witnessed by the positive and caring relationships that exist between all groups.’_

#### ISI Report 2025

In September 2023, a new inspection framework was introduced which changed the nature of both the inspection itself and the report subsequently published. Instead of areas of the school being graded ('excellent' etc), the standards are either 'met' or 'not met'. I am very pleased to confirm that St Mary's met all the standards required, demonstrating full compliance. We are proud that so many areas of the school have been singled out for praise which reflects the quality of the education we provide across the board.

In order to reach their judgements, the 7-strong inspection team interviewed over ¼ of the student body, held meetings with 90 staff attendees (some staff had multiple meetings owing to various areas of responsibility), observed 25 registration and assembly slots, and visited around 100 lessons.

We are thrilled to share some of the report's key findings:

> "Leaders have a clear vision for school development based on effective monitoring and self-evaluation."

> "From early years and upwards, pupils show high levels of respect and tolerance. Consequently, behaviour is good and bullying is rare."

> "Boarding provision is carefully led and managed by knowledgeable and experienced staff. Conscientious supervision and a rigorous approach to safety ensure that boarders feel safe."

> "Teachers have a high level of knowledge and enthusiasm for their subjects."

> "Pupils feel safe and respected, with trusted staff always available."

[**Read the full report**](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/publications-and-media-galleries/reports.htm)

### Diocesan inspection report 2022

Our [Diocesan Inspection report](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/ugc-1/1/6/0/dea_final_report_st_marys_independen.pdf) undertaken by the East Anglia Diocesan Schools’ Service achieved the highest ‘**Grade 1’ rating of Outstanding** in all three areas assessed by inspectors in June 2022: Catholic Life, Religious Education and Collective Worship.  
  
Inspectors praised St Mary’s as: ‘_a school where everyone is respected and valued for who they are_’, with the quality of leadership described as ‘_extremely strong; it is both enterprising and aspirational_.’

> Inspectors reported _‘it is evident that the core Gospel values lie at the heart of life in school, clearly witnessed by the positive and caring relationships that exist between all groups.’_

#### **St Mary's Junior School, Cambridge**

With us, your daughter will [embrace learning](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school/learning.htm), discover her talents and explore how to make a positive contribution to society. Inspired by caring, [specialist teachers](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/junior-school/welcome/junior-school-leadership-team.htm) she will build her critical thinking, curiosity and creativity, alongside her knowledge and skills.

Rated fully compliant and meeting all the standards of the _Independent Schools Inspectorate_, we bring out the best in girls aged three to 11.

[Contact us and discover the opportunities for your daughter.](https://www.stmaryscambridge.co.uk/admissions/contact-us.htm)

#### We will empower your daughter to dream big ...
